name: Culm
author: Erin Carter
description: A reed bed of round, cylinder-shaded bamboo canes in three depth-layered rows receding into the frame, each cane lit with a specular stripe and dark turning edges for real volume, divided by crisp swollen node rings. Gust fronts cross the bed cane by cane; each struck cane answers from the ground up as a sparkle of node glints climbs joint by joint to the leafy tip while the stiff top bows with an elastic overshoot.

params.label: Gust rate
params.effect: How often gust fronts move through the reed bed.

params.label: Bend
params.effect: How far the canes tip and how brightly the climbing glint-run registers at each joint.

params.label: Cane spacing
params.effect: CSS-pixel spacing between canes in the nearest row, from a dense reed bed to a sparse stand.

params.label: Node glow
params.effect: Brightness of the node-ring glints as the sparkle climbs each cane.
